name: design.uproad/uproad
title: Uproad
description: Share prototypes as private links clients open without an account, attach specs, read comments.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Without it the server answers 401 with OAuth discovery (Client ID Metadata Documents, PKCE) and the client signs in through the browser. Clients that cannot do OAuth may instead send `Bearer <token>` with a personal token from https://uproad.design/settings/personal-tokens or a workspace token from https://uproad.design/settings/tokens (admins only).
